mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM shops WHERE shop_id = #{shopId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND is_deleted = false )
mapper.sql: SELECT i.invoice_id AS invoiceId, i.shop_id AS shopId, i.table_id AS tableId, i.profile_id AS profileId, i.total_amount AS totalAmount, i.status::text AS status, i.is_deleted AS isDeleted, i.created_at AS createdAt, i.update_at AS updateAt FROM invoices i WHERE i.invoice_id = #{invoiceId} AND i.deleted_at IS NULL AND i.is_deleted = FALSE FOR UPDATE
SELECT table_id FROM shop_tables WHERE table_id = #{tableId} AND shop_id = #{shopId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND is_deleted = FALSE AND status = 2 FOR UPDATE
SELECT 1 FROM invoices i WHERE i.table_id = #{tableId} AND i.deleted_at IS NULL AND i.is_deleted = FALSE AND i.status = 0
